title: Sales, Service Advisor Analysis and Technician Efficiency offer Last 12 months
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace).
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar.
  2. In the left menu click Sales.
  3. Click the Date control and read the list of choices top to bottom.
  4. In the left menu click Advisor Analysis (its page title reads Service Advisor Analysis).
  5. Click the Date control and read the list.
  6. In the left menu click Technician Efficiency.
  7. Click the Date control and read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3, 5 and 7: Each of the three reports lists Last 12 months in its Date control.
  • Steps 3, 5 and 7: In each list Last 12 months sits below Last year and above Custom.
  • Steps 3, 5 and 7: It is there even though you opened the report from the Reports menu, not from the Dashboard.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 10. Context note: Sales By Customer and Technician Utilization already offer it. Foreign case C327128 (not ours) also checks the Technician Efficiency preset; this case is our own. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 10 to 12 (report pages), used for on-screen labels only.
